data.name: Inspiring Command
data.description: As a standard action, you can issue an inspiring command to an ally. The inspiring command affects one ally who must be within 30 feet of you. The affected ally gains a +2 insight bonus on attack rolls, AC, combat maneuver defense, and skill checks for 1 round. This is a language-dependant mind-affecting effect.|PREVAREQ:InspiringCommandAllies,1
